visualCharacteristics: Fixed vertical indicator on right viewport edge: dashed/segmented line with one segment per page section (main > .section); highlights the active section via IntersectionObserver as user scrolls; segments clickable to scroll to section. NOT a carousel. Colour flips for light sections via data-section-theme.
contentPattern: No authored content required (empty block table, placed in the last section). JS builds one segment per main > .section, excluding a host section that contains only this block.
